limits.scope: Three existing ImageNet images x SR4/Motion; ImageNet256 unconditional pretrained prior; two arms DPS/SHRINK.
limits.baseline: Same original native1000 DDPM learned_range DPS scale=.3; same A75 multiplier formula without calibration, clipping2, or extra gradients.
limits.prior: Different weights AND network architecture from FFHQ; model/data change together, not an isolated dataset effect.
limits.resources: Allocated GPU>=10GiB free before loading; actual input-VJP probe peak+1GiB checked before each run. No precision/resolution changes; resource pause only before attempts.
limits.timing: Complete1000 includes input load/operator/init/sampling/CPU output sync; model loading/probe/measurement creation/metrics/output writes separate; periodic progress bookkeeping included. Same NFE/VJP1000 per arm.
limits.limits: Small fixed previously used panel, one seed. Native local DPS reference, not paper benchmark reproduction. Multiplier module adds no NN/VJP.
